title: VTA did:webs DIDs Rotate-Keys — payload
description: Rotate a did:webs DID to its pre-rotated successor and commit a fresh one, by a KERI rotation event the VTA stages, publishes, then commits. Alpha.

expectedVersionId.description: Precondition: the DID's latest event, as `<sequence number>:<SAID>`, that the caller based this rotation on. Refused with `versionConflict` when the DID has moved on.

Response.title: VTA did:webs DIDs Rotate-Keys — response payload

sequenceNumber.description: Sequence number of the rotation event.

signingKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the signing key the rotation installed: the successor the previous establishment event committed.

signingKey.description: That key in CESR. Its verification method is `<did>#<signingKey>`.

nextKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the fresh successor the rotation committed. Inactive until the next rotation.

retiredKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the signing key the rotation replaced. The VTA signs nothing more with it.

resumed.description: True when the VTA answered by completing a rotation it had already staged, rather than writing a new one: the request is satisfied by that rotation, and no second one was made.
